# authwise_guard_node_group_members (Resource)

The nodes of a Guard node group, by full name (`authwise_guard_node.<name>.name`), as an authoritative set: a member added out of band is removed on the next apply. A node may be in any number of groups.

**Not for groups that credentials fill.** A node that joins with an `authwise_guard_enrollment_key` or under an `authwise_guard_cluster_trust_rule` naming the group is added to it at join, and this resource would remove it on the next apply. Use it for groups of nodes you register yourself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A group of servers registered by hand. Don't manage the members of a
# group that an enrollment key or a cluster trust rule fills: this resource
# would remove the nodes they add.
resource "authwise_guard_node_group" "ops" {
  tenant_id    = "t-01"
  network_id   = authwise_guard_network.office.guard_network_id
  display_name = "ops hosts"
}

resource "authwise_guard_node_group_members" "ops" {
  node_group = authwise_guard_node_group.ops.name
  nodes = [
    authwise_guard_node.bastion.name,
    authwise_guard_node.awx.name,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node_group` (String) Full resource name of the node group.
- `nodes` (Set of String) Full resource names of the associated nodes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the group's full name.
terraform import authwise_guard_node_group_members.ops tenants/t-01/networks/n-01/nodeGroups/ng-02
```
